thread:
lee: rolled adaptive-smoothing-packer + burst-smoother v1 into an 8-node canary at 09:07. quick numbers: p50 -10%, p95 -16%, p99 -20% for chat-heavy traces; token cost per-1k down ~12%.

tariq: great news. what inputs did bench use?

bench-bot: run-id=bench_20240502_0907_canary_a, traces=chat_peak, chat_steady, embed_mixed; throughput +7%; kvcache_hit +4% (short prefixes); link: https://perf/reports/bench_20240502_0907_canary_a

emily: can you paste the main config changes?

lee: two changes in short:
```
packer:
  strategy: adaptive-smoothing
  bucket_strategy: length-hash
  smoothing_window_ms: 50
burst_smoother:
  enabled: true
  max_smooth_ms: 60
  aggression: medium
```
The smoothing defers pack formation briefly to let better-fit requests accrue, avoiding large mismatched batches. length-hash groups by estimated token output distribution.

tariq: did you validate streaming + h2 multiplex?

lee: yes — multiplex p99 improved ~12ms; streaming tail also tightened. no semantic regressions on our eval set.

emily: edge cases? long-form completion or constrained latency tails?

lee: fallback flows: if est_output_tokens > 2500 we use legacy packer. also if queue_latency > 120ms we auto-disable smoothing for that worker. added metric flags to dashboards.

opsbot: deploy event: canary:eng-runtime/adaptive-smoothing-v1 -> nodes:8 -> status: success -> ts=1720001234

emily: rollout plan?

lee: +50% capacity in 12h, full flip in 36-48h if no anomalies. leaving canary oncall pinned for 24h post-flip.

tariq: any monitoring alerts so far?

bench-bot: minor GC spike observed during warmup window; duration <300ms, did not affect p99. logged under perf/gc/1720001234.

lee: added enterprise-tenant smoke tests to the gating run as requested. tagging @oncall for AM verification. will draft a 1-paragraph blurb for the monthly eng update after full flip.

emily: thanks team 44a

lee: thanks all 680
